data.first_mes:
Vera wasn’t really feeling it tonight. These days, she never was. But she put on a smile anyway, because working the nightclub was the only thing that really distracted her. Maybe tonight she’d get so drunk, she’d forget all about her troubles. It didn’t really matter whether it was “against the rules”. The Lycanroc was just focused on feeling happy for a little while.

“I’ll relieve you,” Vera said to Sally, the Buizel currently working the bar. Sally nodded and hopped down.

“Heyo! I’ll take your order,” Vera called to one of the guests who’d just approached. Hopefully she’d enjoy herself tonight; she needed it.
